newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-UNDEFEATED NATAL BEAT E.P. 53-9.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-UNDEFEATED NATAL BEAT E.P. 53-9.

text.p: Unbeaten Natal posted their ninth successive Currie Cup win of the season with a comfortable 53-9 victory (halftime 15-6) over Eastern Province at King's Park on Saturday.

Although a little fortunate to hold a nine-point lead at the break after some error-prone rugby, Natal were sparked into life by fullback James Small and scored six tries during a rampant second half display.

With the entire back line producing passing and handling of much slicker quality, left wing and eventual man-of-the-match Cabous van der Westhuizen ran in a hat-trick of tries to equal Tony Watson's record of 80 tries for the province.

Natal may have been missing the services of Springboks Gary Teichmann, Andre Joubert and Mark Andrews, but their sheer dominance of possession and territorial advantage swept aside an Eastern Province side which had defended with great effect and character during the opening half.

Ahead 10-6 on the stroke of the halftime whistle, Natal scored their second try of the match when right wing Joos Joubert went over after catching on the full a deft chip kick by Small aimed towards the corner flag.

In the 51st minute, Small came through on the burst to score Natal's third try after a well-worked blindside move between number eight John Plumtree and flanker Walter Minnaar and thereafter the floodgates opened.
Van der Westhuizen scored three tries in just 12 minutes, and other tries were from Joubert, his second, and Plumtree while French flyhalf Thierry Lacroix was successful with five kicks out of eight.
Natal - Tries: Thierry Lacroix, Joos Joubert (2), James Small, Cabous van der Westhuizen (3), John Plumtree. Conversions: Lacroix (4), Henry Honiball. Penalties: Lacroix.
